rulings.raw: 4 chicken breasts (2 lbs boneless and skinless)
rulings.evidence: The line names its own form in the prep text - 2 lbs boneless and skinless - which is exactly what the chicken-breast commodity prices at 7 of 7 stores. Food DB row already exists (130 cal / 112 g raw).

Fresh high-moisture mozzarella packed in water is a different product and price class from both the shredded-cheese id the board matched and the low-moisture Mozzarella Cheese row (250 vs 304 cal per 100 g); refusing the bridge and enqueuing the term. New label row added.

Coarse whole-seed prepared mustard: not the yellow mustard the mustard id prices and not smooth Dijon. Same condiment family, specialty jar price class, so no bridge; term enqueued. New label row added.

1/4 cup CHOPPED can only be fresh (a quarter cup of dried parsley is not a garnish). fresh-parsley is an existing live commodity id, so this is a reuse and not a proposal; the Fresh Parsley food row already exists.
